description:
H Property are delighted to present No. 2 Old Quarry to the market, an exceptional four-bedroom detached residence extending to approximately 204 sq.m / 2,200 sq.ft. and forming part of an exclusive development of just three individually designed homes in Glounthaune.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, No. 2 combines generous proportions, contemporary design and an impressive A3 energy rating with a superb layout ideally suited to modern family living.

At the heart of the home is an impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and family room. Extensive glazing together with a large feature rooflight floods this space with natural light, while the contemporary fitted kitchen provides excellent storage together with a substantial island and breakfast bar. Direct access from the living area connects seamlessly with the garden.

A separate living room provides an excellent second reception space and features oak flooring, fitted cabinetry and an inset stove. A dedicated study/home office, utility room and guest WC complete the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs are four generously proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom is particularly spacious and incorporates a walk-in wardrobe and en-suite shower room. Three further double bedrooms are served by a large family bathroom incorporating both a bath and separate walk-in shower.

The quality of the specification is evident throughout, with features including aluminium double-glazed windows, solid oak internal doors and staircase, air-to-water heating, underfloor heating at ground-floor level and heat-recovery ventilation.

Externally, the property enjoys a distinctive landscaped setting with mature planting and a natural quarry backdrop providing considerable character and privacy. An EV charger has also been installed.

LOCATION

Glounthaune is one of Cork's most established and sought-after residential locations, combining an attractive village setting with excellent connectivity to Cork City and East Cork.

The village is particularly well served by local amenities, including the renowned Fitzpatrick's Foodstore and The Elm Tree, together with Glounthaune National School, community and recreational facilities.

Glounthaune Railway Station is a particular advantage, providing direct commuter rail connections to Cork City and access to the Cobh and Midleton lines. The location also enjoys excellent road connectivity, with convenient access to the N25, Dunkettle Interchange and Jack Lynch Tunnel, as well as the major employment centres at Little Island and Carrigtwohill.

The combination of substantial accommodation, contemporary design, excellent energy efficiency and a highly convenient Glounthaune location makes No. 2 Old Quarry an exceptionally attractive family home.
